messages:
Alex W: Heads-up — before the webinar next Tuesday we need a quick plan to stop 404s and capture leads cleanly. I found some orphan pages linking to the old signup path.
Maria (Growth): Ugh, which pages? can we triage by intent + traffic? :pray:
Alex W: Top offenders: two blog posts + the community announcement. Low traffic but SEO value. I sketched a small redirect map and a priority list.
Jamal: Can you drop the map here? I can spin up the redirects in staging and add tests.
Alex W: Pasting CSV snippet for the redirect plan (old_url -> new_landing + utm)
```
/old-webinar -> /webinars/2026-inference-launch?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=webinar
/community/events/launch -> /webinars/2026-inference-launch?utm_source=community&utm_campaign=webinar
/blog/benchmarking-llms -> /resources/benchmark-report-2026?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=bench
```
Alex W: Note: keep query params and drop session tokens.
Oli: Also add canonical tags on the benchmark report landing — we don't want duplicate indexing from older copies.
Maria (Growth): For tracking: we need consistent UTM values so marketing automation can route leads. Can we standardize on utm_campaign=webinar_inference_q1?
Alex W: Yes, switch campaign to `webinar_inference_q1`. Updated CSV above.
SEO Audit Bot: Automated scan: Found 3 pages with missing JSON-LD event schema for webinar CTA. Severity: medium.
Jamal: I'll add JSON-LD snippet to the landing. Example:
```
<script type="application/ld+json">{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference Launch Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-07T16:00:00Z",
  "url": "https://redwood.inference/webinars/2026-inference-launch",
  "offers": {"@type":"Offer","url":"https://redwood.inference/register"}
}
</script>
```
Maria (Growth): Nice. Also add `speakable` or a short description for rich results? Might help CTR.
Oli: Agreed. I'll add speakable and ensure meta og tags for social.
Jamal: For internal linking — can we add 3 contextual links from the benchmark blog to the webinar landing and a CTA block in the top of the post? That will help crawl priority.
Alex W: Yes — prioritize internal links on highest-traffic posts first. I created a mini checklist for the redirect deploy and SEO preflight:
- [ ] apply 301 redirects in staging (Jamal)
- [ ] add JSON-LD + meta tags on landing (Jamal/Oli)
- [ ] update blog posts with contextual links (Maria)
- [ ] QA crawl & screenshot SERP preview (SEO Audit Bot)
- [ ] smoke test UTMs push into Marketo/SFDC mapping (Maria)
Maria (Growth): For lead routing: make webhook map to source=webinar, medium=referral, and set lead_owner via round-robin tag `webinar-handler` in SFDC. Can engineering review? @Jamal
Jamal: Yep — I can add a simple mapping in the inbound webhook transformation. Pseudocode:
```
if (params.utm_campaign == 'webinar_inference_q1') {
  lead.source = 'webinar';
  lead.owner = rotate('webinar-handler');
}
```
Oli: Small SEO note — use 301 for permanent legacy redirects, but for test/preview send a 302 until we've validated.
Alex W: Good call. We'll push 302 in staging and flip to 301 after 24h smoke.
SEO Audit Bot: Re-scan scheduled after deploy. Expected delta: +2 schema items, +3 internal links, 0 soft 404s.
Maria (Growth): Timeline? We need redirects and landing updates live 72h before the webinar for crawlers.
Jamal: I can have staging ready in 10 hours, deploy to production in morning (48h before).
Alex W: Perfect. I'll track in the launch doc and ping legal if any copy changes affect policy.
Maria (Growth): Thanks team — I'll coordinate copy + Marketo mapping. Ping me when redirects are live and I'll run a quick lead simulation. :rocket:
